##### TCR

```{r Load TCR and keep only the one for the cells that were filtered during GEX analysis}
library(scRepertoire) #For TCR and BCR annotation
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds")) #load Tcells dataset
seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% subset(subset = !clusters_harmony %in% c(8,12)) #remove cluster 8 and 12: not biologicly relevent

files_vdj_T <- list.files(filepath, include.dirs = T, recursive = T, full.names = T, pattern = "filtered_contig_annotations") %>% str_subset("vdj_t")
name_T <-  files_vdj_T %>% str_replace(pattern = ".*per_sample_outs/", replacement = "") %>% str_replace(pattern = "/vdj_t.*", replacement = "")
name_T <- paste0("S_", name_T)

# load TCR 
data_tcr <- lapply(files_vdj_T, read.csv) 
combined_TCR <- combineTCR(data_tcr, 
                           samples = name_T,
                           removeNA = TRUE, 
                           removeMulti = FALSE, 
                           filterMulti = TRUE)

#add metadata
combined_TCR <- lapply(combined_TCR, function(df){
  mylist <- df$sample %>% str_sub(5) %>% str_split("_") %>% .[[1]]
  df$donor <- mylist[1]
  df$visit <- mylist[2]
  df$day <- mylist[3]
  return(df)
})

combined_TCR <- combined_TCR[!grepl("Unstim", names(combined_TCR))] #filter Unstim sample: not relevent
names_old <- names(combined_TCR) 
names_new <- c(
  "1_NA1", "1_WVA01_d0", "1_WVA01_d7", "1_WVA01_mo6", "1_WVA02_d0", "1_WVA02_d7",
  "2_NA2", "2_WVA03_d0", "2_WVA03_d7", "2_WVA03_mo6", "2_WVA04_d0", "2_WVA04_d7", "2_WVA04_mo6",
  "3_NA3", "3_WVA05_d0", "3_WVA05_d7", "3_WVA05_mo6", "3_WVA06_d0", "3_WVA06_d7", "3_WVA06_mo6",  
  "4_NA4", "4_WVA07_d0", "4_WVA07_d7", "4_WVA07_mo6", "4_WVA08_d0", "4_WVA08_d7", "4_WVA08_mo6", 
  "5_NA5", "5_WVA09_d0", "5_WVA09_d7", "5_WVA09_mo6", "5_WVA10_d0", "5_WVA10_d7", "5_WVA10_mo6" 
  ) 
df_names_new <- data.frame(sampleid = names_old, sampleid_new = names_new)
#QC: n_TCR per file and per batch
p <- data.frame(
  samples = names_new,
  n_TCR = sapply(combined_TCR, nrow)) %>% 
  mutate(batch = sub(".*?([0-9]+).*", "\\1", samples)) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(samples, n_TCR, fill = batch)) + 
    geom_col() + 
    theme_pubr + theme_x_angled + theme_grid + theme_fonts +
    theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "QC_nTCR_batch.svg"), width = 8, height = 4)
p
dev.off()

#Very little clone information in the Batch 1: Experimental error: filtering out
combined_TCR <- combined_TCR[!grepl("S_1_", names(combined_TCR))]

#####
# Remove cells which are not present in the Tcells datasets (cells that where filtered out)
combined_TCR_filter <- combined_TCR 

#loop through files to retain the filtered cells from the scRNAseq
for (i in 1:length(names(combined_TCR_filter))) {
  sample <- names(combined_TCR_filter)[i]

  screp_barcodes <- combined_TCR[[i]]$barcode
  seurat_barcodes <- rownames(seurat_T@meta.data[seurat_T@meta.data$sampleid == sample %>% str_sub(5),])
  
  TCR_clonotype_barcodes_filtered <- subset(combined_TCR[[i]], screp_barcodes %in% (seurat_barcodes ))
  combined_TCR_filter[[i]] <- TCR_clonotype_barcodes_filtered
}

#Add metadata to the table
metadata <- seurat_T@meta.data %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% 
  filter(!group %in% c("Unstim")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(
    group == "Non-allergic" ~ "Non-allergic",
    (group == "Allergic" & visit == "V1" & day == "d0") ~ "d0",
    (group == "Allergic" & visit == "V1" & day == "d7") ~ "d7",
    (group == "Allergic" & visit == "V2" & day == "d0") ~ "mo6"
  )) %>% 
  select("barcode","sampleid", "donor", "visit", "day", "timepoint", "group", "clusters_harmony") %>% 
  left_join(
    df_names_new %>% 
      mutate(sampleid = str_sub(sampleid, 5),
             sampleid_new = str_sub(sampleid_new, 3))
      )
```

```{r TCR clonality analysis}
#####
# Explore TCR clonality
#Make clonality table
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds")) #load Tcells dataset
seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% subset(subset = !clusters_harmony %in% c(8,12)) #remove cluster 8 and 12: not
combined_TCR_filter <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\TCR\\scRepertoire_TCR_filtered.rds"))
TCR <- combined_TCR_filter

names_new <- c(
  "1_NA1", "1_WVA01_d0", "1_WVA01_d7", "1_WVA01_mo6", "1_WVA02_d0", "1_WVA02_d7",
  "2_NA2", "2_WVA03_d0", "2_WVA03_d7", "2_WVA03_mo6", "2_WVA04_d0", "2_WVA04_d7", "2_WVA04_mo6",
  "3_NA3", "3_WVA05_d0", "3_WVA05_d7", "3_WVA05_mo6", "3_WVA06_d0", "3_WVA06_d7", "3_WVA06_mo6",  
  "4_NA4", "4_WVA07_d0", "4_WVA07_d7", "4_WVA07_mo6", "4_WVA08_d0", "4_WVA08_d7", "4_WVA08_mo6", 
  "5_NA5", "5_WVA09_d0", "5_WVA09_d7", "5_WVA09_mo6", "5_WVA10_d0", "5_WVA10_d7", "5_WVA10_mo6" 
  ) 
names(combined_TCR_filter) <- names_new[7:34] %>% str_sub(3)

df_clonality <- clonalQuant(combined_TCR_filter, cloneCall="aa", chain = "both", scale = T, exportTable = T) %>% 
  rename("sample" = "values") %>% 
  separate(sample, into = c("donor", "timepoint"), sep="_") %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(str_starts(donor, "NA"), "Non-allergic", "Allergic")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(group == "Non-allergic", "Non-allergic", timepoint))


df_clonality %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Non-allergic", "d0")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(group, scaled)) +
    geom_point()

df_clonality %>% 
  filter(group == "Allergic") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(timepoint, scaled)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line(aes(group = donor))

TCR_list_clusters <- bind_rows(combined_TCR_filter) %>% 
  left_join(
  seurat_T@meta.data %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    select(clusters_harmony) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("barcode")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(sample, clusters_harmony) %>% 
  group_split() 
names(TCR_list_clusters) <- c(1:length(TCR_list_clusters))

  clonalQuant(TCR_list_clusters, cloneCall="aa", chain = "both", scale = T, exportTable = T) %>% 
  rename("sample" = "values") %>% 
  separate(sample, into = c("donor", "timepoint"), sep="_") %>% 
  mutate(group = ifelse(str_starts(donor, "NA"), "Non-allergic", "Allergic")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(group == "Non-allergic", "Non-allergic", timepoint))



#n of clones per files: scaled
svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Clonality_scaled.svg"), width = 6, height = 4)
clonalQuant(combined_TCR_filter, cloneCall="aa", chain = "both", scale = T) + 
  labs(x=NULL) +
  theme_pubr + theme_x_angled + theme_grid + theme_fonts + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))
dev.off()

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Clonality_scaled_Allergic.svg"), width = 6, height = 4)
clonalQuant(combined_TCR_filter[!grepl("NA", names(combined_TCR_filter))],
            cloneCall="aa", chain = "both", scale = T) +

  theme_pubr + theme_x_angled + theme_grid + theme_fonts + theme(legend.position = "none") +

dev.off()


#Top 10 clones proportion

clonalProportion(
  combined_TCR_filter[!grepl("NA", names(combined_TCR_filter))], 
  cloneCall = "aa", clonalSplit = c(1, 10, 25, 100, 500, 1e+05))  +
  labs(x=NULL) +
  theme_pubr(legend="right") + theme_x_angled + theme_grid + theme_fonts +
  theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))
dev.off()


#Clone overlap between samples
df_list <- combined_TCR_filter[order(names(combined_TCR_filter))] #reorder alphabeticaly
mat <- clonalOverlap(df_list,
              cloneCall = "aa", method = "overlap", exportTable = TRUE) 
mat <- round(mat,2) 
# mat[mat <= .01] <- 0
coef_matrix_as_matrix <- as.matrix(mat)
mat_melt <- data.frame(
  Var1 = rep(rownames(coef_matrix_as_matrix), ncol(coef_matrix_as_matrix)), 
  Var2 = rep(colnames(coef_matrix_as_matrix), each = nrow(coef_matrix_as_matrix)), 
  value = as.vector(coef_matrix_as_matrix))

p <- ggplot(mat_melt, aes(x = .data[["Var1"]], y = .data[["Var2"]], fill = .data[["value"]])) +
  geom_tile() + 
  geom_tile(data = mat_melt[!is.na(mat_melt[, "value"]), ], 
            fill = NA, lwd = 0.25, color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = viridis::inferno(100), na.value = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, digits = 2), color = ifelse(value <= .01, "white", 
        "black")), na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(x=NULL, x=NULL) +
  theme_pubr(legend="right") + theme_x_angled + theme_grid + theme_fonts +
  theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))

 
svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "Clonality_overlap_samples.svg"), width = 12, height = 9)
p
dev.off()

clonalCompare(combined_TCR_filter, samples = c("A05_d0", "A05_d7", "A05_mo6"), top.clones = 10,  cloneCall="aa", graph = "alluvial") +

clonalCompare(combined_TCR_filter, samples = c("A06_d0", "A06_d7", "A06_mo6"), top.clones = 10,  cloneCall="aa", graph = "alluvial") +
```

```{r TCR clonal dynamic}
#####
# Explore TCR clonality
#Make clonality table
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds")) #load Tcells dataset
seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% subset(subset = !clusters_harmony %in% c(8,12) & !batch == 1 & !group == "Unstim")
combined_TCR_filter <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\TCR\\scRepertoire_TCR_filtered.rds"))

seurat_T[["timepoint"]] <- case_when(
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V1" & seurat_T$day == "d0") ~ "d0",
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V1" & seurat_T$day == "d7") ~ "d7",
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V2" & seurat_T$day == "d0") ~ "mo6",
  (seurat_T$group == "Non-allergic") ~ "Non-allergic"
  )

seurat_T[["clusters_names"]] <- recode(seurat_T$"clusters_harmony",  !!!names)

seurat_T_TCR <- combineExpression(combined_TCR_filter, seurat_T, 
                                  cloneCall="aa", proportion = F, group.by = NULL,
                                  cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500)
                                  )


#keep only allergic donors
combined_TCR_filter <- combined_TCR_filter[str_detect(names(combined_TCR_filter), "H9")]

#rename TCR_filter
donor <- names(combined_TCR_filter) %>% str_sub(5, -7)
donor_title <- c("WVA03", "WVA04", "WVA05", "WVA06", "WV0A07", "WVA08", "WVA09", "WVA10")

timepoints <- names(combined_TCR_filter) %>% str_sub(10) 
timepoints <- case_when(
  timepoints == "V1_d0" ~ "d0", 
  timepoints == "V1_d7" ~ "d7",
  timepoints == "V2_d0" ~ "mo6"
          )
names(combined_TCR_filter) <- paste0(donor, "_", timepoints)


#data to highlight treg clones
Treg_clones <- seurat_T_TCR@meta.data %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  select(donor, timepoint, CTaa, clusters_names) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = paste0(donor, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  select(- donor, -timepoint) %>% 
  rename(original.clones = CTaa) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = ifelse(
    clusters_names %in% c("Treg act low", "Treg act high"), "Treg", "Tconv")
    ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(clusters_names == "Treg") %>% 
  pull(original.clones)

# All population

for(donor_sub in unique(donor)){

data <- combined_TCR_filter[

                  cloneCall="CTaa",

                  relabel.clones = T,

  print(donor_sub)
}
plots
```

# Combine to Seurat object and uses scRepertoire tools

```{r TCR combine to Seurat object}
#Combine to Seurat obj per sample
seurat_T <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\seurat_obj\\seurat_Tcells_Integrated.rds")) #load Tcells dataset
seurat_T <- seurat_T %>% subset(subset = !clusters_harmony %in% c(8,12) & !batch == 1 & !group == "Unstim")
combined_TCR_filter <- readRDS(paste0(wd, "data\\out\\TCR\\scRepertoire_TCR_filtered.rds"))

seurat_T[["timepoint"]] <- case_when(
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V1" & seurat_T$day == "d0") ~ "d0",
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V1" & seurat_T$day == "d7") ~ "d7",
  (seurat_T$group != "Non-allergic" & seurat_T$visit == "V2" & seurat_T$day == "d0") ~ "mo6",
  (seurat_T$group == "Non-allergic") ~ "Non-allergic"
  )

seurat_T[["clusters_names"]] <- recode(seurat_T$"clusters_harmony",  !!!names)

seurat_T_TCR <- combineExpression(combined_TCR_filter, seurat_T, 
                                  cloneCall="aa", proportion = F, group.by = NULL,
                                  cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500)
                                  )


#Add clusters from TCRdist3 by matching
#Import after TCRdist3
TCR_clust <- read_csv("C:\\Users\\flore\\OneDrive - Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin\\BCRT\\Food@\\R\\Food@Sequencing\\data\\TCRdist\\TCR_clusters.csv") %>% 
  rename("TCR_cluster" = "leiden_cluster") %>% 
  mutate(CTaa = paste0(cdr3_a_aa, "_", cdr3_b_aa)) %>% 
  select(CTaa, TCR_cluster) %>% 
  distinct()

TCR_clust <- data.frame(y=1:length(seurat_T_TCR@meta.data[["CTaa"]]), CTaa = seurat_T_TCR@meta.data[["CTaa"]]) %>% 
  left_join(TCR_clust) %>% 
  distinct(y, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  arrange(y)

seurat_T_TCR$TCR_cluster <- as.vector(TCR_clust["TCR_cluster"])

```

```{r TCR clonality on umap and cluster harmony}
#Define color palette 
colorblind_vector <- hcl.colors(n=7, palette = "inferno", fixup = TRUE)

DimPlot(seurat_T_TCR, reduction = "umap_harmony",  combine = TRUE, group.by = c("cloneSize")) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  scale_color_manual(values=rev(colorblind_vector[c(1,3,5,7)]))


df_umap_tcr <- Embeddings(seurat_T_TCR, reduction = "umap_harmony") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>% 
  left_join(seurat_T_TCR@meta.data %>% 
              select(group, cloneSize, clusters_harmony,clusters_names, clonalFrequency, donor, visit, day) %>% 
              rownames_to_column("id")
            ) %>% 
  slice_sample(prop = 1) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cloneSize)) %>% 
  mutate(cloneSize = recode_factor(cloneSize, 
                                   "Single (0 < X <= 1)" = "Single (1)",
                                   "Small (1 < X <= 5)" = "Small (2:5)",
                                   "Medium (5 < X <= 20)" = "Medium (6:20)",
                                   "Large (20 < X <= 100)" = "Large (21:100)"
                                   )) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(
    (visit=="V1" & day=="d0") ~"d0",
    (visit=="V1" & day=="d7") ~"d7",
    (visit=="V2" & day=="d0") ~"mo6",
  ))

#Export for statistics
df_umap_tcr %>% write.csv(paste0(filepath_tables, "TCR_Clonality.csv"),row.names = FALSE)

p <- df_umap_tcr %>% 
  ggplot(aes(umapharmony_1, umapharmony_2, col = cloneSize)) +
  geom_point(size = .25, alpha = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values=rev(colorblind_vector[c(7,5,3,1)])) +
  labs(x="UMAP", y="UMAP") +
  theme_pubr(legend = "top") + theme_fonts + theme_facet +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2), nrow=2), byrow = TRUE) +
  theme(legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -10, 0), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, -5, 0))

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "umap_Clonality.svg"), width = 3.5, height = 4)
p
dev.off()


#plot clonality per clusters
cols <- brewer.pal(10, "Set3")

p <- df_umap_tcr %>% select(clusters_names, clonalFrequency) %>% 
  group_by(clusters_names) %>% 
  summarise(mean_freq = mean(clonalFrequency)) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = factor(clusters_names, levels= order)) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(clusters_names, mean_freq, fill=clusters_names)) +
  geom_col(width = .75) +
  labs(x=NULL, y="Clone size (mean)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  cols) +
  theme_pubr() + theme_fonts + theme_grid + theme_x_angled +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r TCR circos plots d0}
# circle plot  
#Even if throw error messages: still succesfull
seurat_T_TCR_d0 <- seurat_T_TCR %>% subset(subset = timepoint == "d0")
cols <- brewer.pal(10, "Set3")
fn_circos <- function(df, plot_title = NULL) {
  
  df %>%
    getCirclize(
      cloneCall = "CTaa",
      method = "jaccard",
      group.by = "clusters_names",
      include.self = TRUE,
      proportion = TRUE
    ) %>%
    mutate(value = ifelse(value < 0.01, 0, value)) %>%
    chordDiagram(
      grid.col = cols,
      link.border = "black",
      transparency = 0.3,
      order = order,
      annotationTrack = "grid",
      preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.26),
      self.link = 1
    )
  
  # Cluster labels
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector.name <- CELL_META$sector.index
      xlim <- CELL_META$xlim
      
      circos.text(
        mean(xlim),
        CELL_META$ylim[1],
        sector.name,
        facing = "clockwise",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5),
        cex = 0.75
      )
    },
    bg.border = NA
  )
  
  # Donor title
  if (!is.null(plot_title)) {
    title(plot_title, cex.main = 1.5, font.main = 2)
  }
}

seurat_T_TCR_d0 %>%

    message("")
```

```{r TCR circos plots dynamic}
fn_circos <- function(df, plot_title = NULL, time1 = NULL, time2 = NULL, order = NULL){
  df %>% 
    getCirclize(cloneCall = "CTaa",
                method = "unique", 
                group.by = c("timepoint_Cluster"),
                proportion = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(str_detect(from, paste0("^", time1)), str_detect(to,paste0("^", time2))) %>% 
  mutate(value = ifelse(value < 0.005, 0, value)) %>% 

  chordDiagram(grid.col = cols,
               link.border = "black", 
               transparency = 0.3, 
               order = order,
               annotationTrack = "grid", 
               preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.35))
    
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector.name = CELL_META$sector.index
    xlim = CELL_META$xlim

    circos.text(
      mean(xlim),
      CELL_META$ylim[1],
      sector.name,
      facing = "clockwise",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5),
      cex = 0.70
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)
  # Donor title
  if (!is.null(plot_title)) {
    title(plot_title, cex.main = 1.5, font.main = 2)
  }
}
```

```{r TCR uses StartracDiversity with scRepertoire}
cols <- brewer.pal(10, "Set3")

sc_TCR <- seurat_T_TCR %>% 
  subset(subset = timepoint %in% c("d0", "d7", "mo6")) %>% 
  subset(subset =!is.na(CTaa))

#All scores
p <- sc_TCR %>%  
  StartracDiversity(cloneCall = "CTaa", type = "timepoint", group.by = "donor", export.table = T, index=c("expa", "tran")) %>% 
  mutate(clusters_names = recode(cluster, !!!names),
         clusters_names = factor(clusters_names, levels = unlist(names))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(expa:tran), names_to = "names", values_to = "Values") %>% 
  mutate(names = recode(names, "expa" = "Expansion", "tran" = "Transition")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=clusters_names, y=Values, fill=clusters_names))+
  facet_grid(rows=vars(names), scales = "free") +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", width =0.75)+ 
    geom_boxplot(width = .25) +
    geom_point(size=1, alpha=.5) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="STARTRAC scores") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) + scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_pubr() + theme_fonts + theme_grid + theme_x_angled +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

svglite(paste0(filepath_plots, "T_Clusters_StarTrac_all.svg"), width = 14, height = 6)
p
dev.off()
```
